findings.title: Archive and CSV work runs on the UI coroutine; iOS document I/O is synchronous there too
findings.explanation: Store Executor uses Main. withContext inside createArchive/database/document operations returns before codec.encode/decode and BatchHistoryCsv.encode execute. iOS document port directly performs NSData read/write without dispatcher switch. Large photo archives can freeze interactions and cannot promptly cancel; tests inject Unconfined and do not assert the execution dispatcher. This contradicts quality.md non-functional requirement to keep import/hashing/backup/restore/CSV off main.
findings.smallestUsefulProof: Record execution thread or dispatchers for encode/decode/CSV/native document access through real Store, use a multiple-photo fixture and verify cancellation can interrupt expensive processing.

findings.title: Public command preparation strips authored whitespace
findings.explanation: prepare() applies trim() to every string argument, including observation text and user-authored recipe metadata. Entered text with leading/trailing spaces/newlines is changed before saveObservation preserves it. The existing verbatim-text test constructs Observation directly and bypasses the broken production command path.
findings.smallestUsefulProof: Public OBSERVATION_EDITOR EditField(text, "  note\n  ") -> Submit(save-observation) -> reopen must equal exact input, including whitespace; repeat for edit and archive round-trip.

findings.title: AC-named component forwarding fixtures do not substantiate all declared component behavior
findings.explanation: ScenarioManager ignores command semantics and returns a result supplied by each test. These tests prove forwarding, model projection and generic deduplication only. Real SQLite component/root tests now prove selected stage/harvest/abandon/repeat/preference flows; they do not supply independent proof for every CRUD/restart/permission/backup declared component surface. Source-inspected matrix entries intentionally remain short of verified.
findings.smallestUsefulProof: For uncovered required component pairs use public component/router actions connected to production manager and actual persistence, assert observable state/navigation and failure/restart behavior. Do not count an AC name alone.

Bounded historical Android smoke exists but its own report lists unverified cases.
